name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog:
Added the ability to cancel a download in progress: click the "Download to server" pill again while it's downloading (it now shows a percentage and "click to cancel") to stop it - the partially-written file is deleted and the connection to the friend's server is closed immediately, rather than letting it run to completion in the background with no way to stop it. This also fixes a real gap: the download job previously ignored its cancellation token entirely, so there was no way to interrupt one even server-side.

A failed or cancelled download now leaves the pill clickable again right away (labeled "Failed - retry?") instead of stuck in a dead-end state, so retrying doesn't require leaving and reopening the item's page.

Also, for anyone wondering: downloads already go directly from your friend's server to yours over a plain authenticated HTTP request - no relay, no third party, no cloud service in between. This release doesn't change that, just adds a way to stop one partway through.

196 tests (up from 194).
